content.short: MetaMask is a popular EVM-compatible crypto wallet.
content.description: Established in 2016, MetaMask ranks among the most popular multi-chain Ethereum software wallets. It enables users to buy and send ERC-20 tokens and to store NFTs, while offering strong cross-device support on both desktop and mobile. The wallet connects to a broad ecosystem of decentralized applications and protocols, facilitating seamless interaction with a diverse set of services across the networks it supports.
